selected_branches.branch: Crossing during flashing indication with countdown

law_text: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 484B.287 [NRS-484B-287-1c, NRS-484B-287-1d, NRS-484B-287-1e, LVMC-11-30-060-A, LVMC-11-30-060-B], 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B] and 484B.350 [LVMC-11-46-030]: Whenever signals exhibiting the words “Walk,” “Don’t Walk,” “Wait” or similar symbols are in place, such signals indicate as follows: While the “Don’t Walk” or “Wait” indication or an upraised hand symbol is illuminated, is flashing and is accompanied by a countdown timer, a pedestrian may proceed across the highway in the direction of the signal, but must complete the crossing before the countdown timer gets to zero.
